description: Straßenbeleuchtung der Gemeinde Algermissen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Street lighting is part of the street equipment and is used to artificially illuminate roads, paths and squares. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Street lighting of the municipality of Algermissen" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include inspireidentifiziert. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
